integrity: No independent mathematical audit or external certification was performed. Numerical finite checks are corroborative, not substitutes for the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: The enumerating polynomial itself was established previously by Mukherjee and Ray; novelty is asserted only for the independently proved complex-root census. The result covers only one-long-arm spiders, not arbitrary trees. Historical priority is provisional and unindexed algebraic equivalents remain possible.
title: A degree-independent right-half-plane root staircase for connected zero forcing on one-long-arm spiders
